root_cause.text: In `nfnl_cthelper_dump_table()` the `goto restart` logic in `net/netfilter/nfnetlink_cthelper.c` was placed after the bucket `for` loop, so if the saved `cb->args[1]` helper disappeared the loop could finish with `cb->args[0] == nf_ct_helper_hsize` and then jump back into the loop body past the bounds check, causing an out-of-bounds read from `nf_ct_helper_hash`.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description says “the 'goto restart' block was meant to re-traverse the current bucket … but it was placed after the for loop instead of inside it,” and the patch moves `if (cb->args[1]) { cb->args[1] = 0; goto restart; }` from after the loop to inside the loop body to prevent restarting when `cb->args[0]` is already out of bounds.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix the placement of the netlink dump restart check so iteration restarts occur in the correct loop context.
intent_record.what: The `if (cb->args[1]) { cb->args[1] = 0; goto restart; }` block was moved inside the surrounding `for`/`while` loop body by shifting its closing braces, so the `restart` check is now executed only within that loop iteration scope instead of after the loop.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this changes when the function decides to reset `cb->args[1]` and jump back to `restart`: the restart condition is now evaluated as part of the loop processing rather than after the loop has finished, which can alter pagination or iteration flow when dumping netlink table entries.
